key_point: The Prince of Persia was a real kid
title: The Prince of Persia was a real kid
caption: The Prince's smooth moves were copied from a real person. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #princeofpersia #broderbund

instagram.caption:
The Prince in the original Prince of Persia moves the way he does because he was a real person.

Creator Jordan Mechner filmed his younger brother David running, jumping and climbing in a parking lot, then traced the footage frame by frame.

The result looked more lifelike than anything in games at the time, and it all came from a home video of two brothers.

Who would you have filmed?
